lines.text: A new token launches. The team posts a roadmap.
lines.caption: A new token launches. The team posts a roadmap.

lines.text: A mobile app. Mainnet. Big partnerships. Everyone's excited.
lines.caption: A mobile app. Mainnet. Big partnerships. Everyone's excited.

lines.text: Here's the catch. On day one, the team already holds a giant pile of those tokens.
lines.caption: Here's the catch. On day one, the team already holds a giant pile of those tokens.

lines.text: They're locked in vesting, which unlocks a little more every month.
lines.caption: They're locked in vesting, which unlocks a little more every month.

lines.text: But vesting only watches the calendar. It never checks the work.
lines.caption: But vesting only watches the calendar. It never checks the work.

lines.text: A year later, every token is unlocked. And the app? Still coming soon.
lines.caption: A year later, every token is unlocked. And the app? Still coming soon.

lines.text: From the outside, you can't tell the builders from the talkers. On day one, they look exactly the same.
lines.caption: From the outside, you can't tell the builders from the talkers. On day one, they look exactly the same.

lines.text: So holders trust less, and honest teams pay the price.
lines.caption: So holders trust less, and honest teams pay the price.

lines.text: What if tokens only unlocked when the promise was actually kept?
lines.caption: What if tokens only unlocked when the promise was actually kept?

lines.text: The team locks its tokens in a vault, split into milestones anyone can check.
lines.caption: The team locks its tokens in a vault, split into milestones anyone can check.

lines.text: Ship a release on GitHub. Put the website live. Deploy the contract. Hit a number on chain.
lines.caption: Ship a release on GitHub. Put the website live. Deploy the contract. Hit a number onchain.

lines.text: When the deadline hits, nobody takes the team's word for it.
lines.caption: When the deadline hits, nobody takes the team's word for it.

lines.text: The I M D swarm checks. Nine independent AI agents look for themselves, and seven have to agree.
lines.caption: The IMD swarm checks. 9 independent AI agents look for themselves, and 7 have to agree.

lines.text: Promise kept? Those tokens go to the team.
lines.caption: Promise kept? Those tokens go to the team.

lines.text: Promise broken? They burn. Gone for good.
lines.caption: Promise broken? They burn. Gone for good.

lines.text: And it's real. KEPT locked three hundred million of its own tokens on Robinhood Chain, and the swarm has already confirmed two promises.
lines.caption: And it's real. KEPT locked 300 million of its own tokens on Robinhood Chain, and the swarm has already confirmed two promises.

lines.text: Don't trust the roadmap. Check it.
lines.caption: Don't trust the roadmap. Check it.
